page.layout: One page of text, one column of verse. A fleuron band runs above the title. Title and subtitle are centred, then the sonnet runs in one column below. Signatures are set right below the last line. No margin notes. Show-through from the reverse is faint on the right and is left out.

main_text.head: A M. JAQUEMOT. SUR SA VERSION DES LAMENTATIONS DE Jeremie.
main_text.p: TOY qui vas repleurant la chanson lamentable Du Cigne d'Anatot sur la saincte Cité, Lasque tu as choisi sur ton lut contristé Un Air bien accordât à ce temps deplorable!
Quel desert si lointain, quel Roc inhabitable N'a quelque esclat piteux de ton Peuple escarté, (monté Et quel fleuue, ô bon Dieu! n'a son bord sur- Recueillant de nos yeux le flot inespuisable!

Les septante ans Seigneur, sont ils point ac- complis? Ne serons nous jamais en ton parc restablis Te retournãt vers nous d'une face plus coye! Verrons nous point Babel lamēter à son tour, Ta Sion repeuplee au Gallique seiour, Et Jaquemot en faire un cantique de joye?

page.notes: The word "(monté" stands at the right end of the line "carté," within the text block. It is printed in parentheses and is probably a rhyme completion or annotation, so it is kept in the line as printed. "sainćte" is written as "saincte" because the scan is unclear. Long s is plain s throughout. "restablis" and "Ne serons" are printed as on the scan. Verse lines are grouped by stanza, not by the 14-line sonnet count, since the printed lines do not fall into 14 lines. Show-through text on the right margin and the faint ornament are excluded.
